title: Right-endpoint sum
text: Divide [a,b] into $$n$$ equal pieces of width $$dx=\frac{b-a}{n}$$. $$R_n$$ adds f at the right end of each piece, then multiplies by dx.

title: Evaluate
text: $$f(x)=\left(x-1\right)^2$$, $$dx=0.5$$, and the right endpoints are $$0.5$$, $$1$$, $$1.5$$, $$2$$. The values are $$0.25$$, $$0$$, $$0.25$$, $$1$$, which add to $$1.5$$. Multiply by $$0.5$$ to get $$0.75$$.
